hero.title: No crowd waiting at the door
hero.subtitle: Visitors scan a QR code to join the queue and get notified when they're called. No paper tickets, no queue-jumping.

qr.title: QR at the counter
qr.description: Each counter or window has its own QR code. It refreshes automatically, so it can't be reused or faked.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: The visitor points their phone camera at the code and joins the queue instantly, no app required.

wait.title: Ticket and position
wait.description: The number, position, and estimated wait time show on the visitor's phone and update on their own.

call.title: Call
call.description: When it's their turn, the visitor's phone notifies them and their number appears on the hall screen.

clinics.title: Clinics and hospitals
clinics.description: Patients wait in the hallway or outside, not crowded around the doctor's door.

gov.title: Public service centers
gov.description: Several windows serving the same request share one queue and one ticket counter.

banks.title: Banks
banks.description: Each type of transaction gets its own queue, and every counter's load is visible in real time.

universities.title: Universities
universities.description: Admissions and the registrar's office handle applicants and students through the same queue system.

antiFraud.title: Protection against queue fraud
antiFraud.description: The QR code on screen refreshes every few minutes, so an old screenshot can't hold a spot.

realtime.title: Real time
realtime.description: Queue position, counter status, and calls update instantly, without refreshing the page.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Average wait and service time, no-show rate, and load by hour all land in one report.

cta.title: Bring your organization online
cta.subtitle: Send us a request and we'll help set up the queue for your counters and services.
